investigation_notes.Description: An Azure Network Security Group named nsg-prod-edge-01 was deleted by user mateo.rodriguez@globalcorp.ee from IP 186.155.12.88 (Bogotá, Colombia). The action occurred at 16:45 local Estonia time on 2026-02-10, which is within typical working hours, but the origin IP geolocation is inconsistent with Estonia-based operations. The user has Contributor rights, which permit NSG deletions; combined with the geographic anomaly and the potential impact of removing a security control, this warrants elevated scrutiny and further investigation to confirm legitimacy. The overall context suggests possible unauthorized activity or a misattributed deployment, requiring confirmation with the user and review of recent deployment activity.
